SILERO RUSSIAN TEXT TO SPEECH

Silero Team and silero-models contributors
Project: https://github.com/snakers4/silero-models
Model: v5_6_ru; selected voice: eugene; application sample rate: 24000 Hz
Original model: https://models.silero.ai/models/tts/ru/v5_6_ru.pt
Upstream license: https://github.com/snakers4/silero-models/blob/master/LICENSE

License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International
(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Full text accompanies this notice in
LICENSE.Silero-CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.txt and is also available at:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode.en

Project changes: local full-JIT export split into core.pt, homosolver.pt,
accentor.pt and resources.json for the Android adapter. The eugene voice was
not retrained. The exported model data and any project adaptations of that
data are provided under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, including the same attribution,
NonCommercial and ShareAlike conditions. This is an unofficial integration.
Neither the project nor its authors claim endorsement by Silero.

The model is provided as-is, without warranties. Retain attribution, license
notices, source links and modification statements. Noncommercial sharing is
permitted under the license terms. This archive grants no commercial model
license and imposes no additional restrictions on rights granted by CC.

GIGAAM SPEECH RECOGNITION

Copyright (c) 2024 GigaChat Team
Project: https://github.com/salute-developers/GigaAM
Model family: GigaAM-v3 E2E RNNT
License: MIT. The full copyright and permission notice accompanies this file
as LICENSE.GigaAM-punct.

Used ONNX conversion by csukuangfj:
https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-transducer-punct-giga-am-v3-russian-2025-12-16
Exact conversion revision: a6039be7cee829a9044a69ac0ebaf1c191217c97
License source:
https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-transducer-punct-giga-am-v3-russian-2025-12-16/blob/a6039be7cee829a9044a69ac0ebaf1c191217c97/LICENSE

Project packaging contains the unchanged encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.onnx,
joiner.onnx and tokens.txt from that conversion plus a project manifest.
The original checkpoint-to-ONNX equivalence was not independently proved
by this archive. The exact conversion file hashes are pinned in source.
